Studied: Support Engineering.description:
⚙️ You studied support design: an engineering program, a technical high school or nights spent rebuilding broken gear.

🌱 How support items are designed, tested and fitted to a Quirk. You can diagnose a fault and suggest gear that covers a Quirk's weakness.
⚠️ New inventions, high-power systems and miniaturized parts still fail more often than they work.
⚖️ Hero gear needs approval from a school, an agency or a licensed support company, and building gear for criminals is a crime.
🏫 It shows in notebooks of sketches and a habit of taking things apart.

📈 Grants: Support Engineering +15
